content: Do not count the faults of others when your own chest is packed with flaws. Look first to your own mirror.
author: Kabir
explanation: The human ego loves the cheap dopamine of judging others' shortcomings while remaining blind to its own deep-seated defects. Spiritual maturity begins with radical self-examination.
practicalInsight: Catch yourself before criticizing a colleague or family member today. Redirect that observational lens toward your own habits.
reflectionPrompt: What fault in others am I condemning that secretly mirrors my own unresolved flaw?
